Definition: Kamon, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Kamon is the place where Jair died and was buried. He had judged Israel two and twenty years.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the burial place as the end of a judge's story, and the record is brief because the life was faithful.
